name: Mount Nimba Strict Nature Reserve
story: Mount Nimba Strict Nature Reserve covers 175.4 km2 in Guinea and Côte d'Ivoire. Established in 1943 and 1944, it is a protected area and UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring exceptional flora and fauna.
matters: The reserve lies within the Guinean Forests of West Africa Biodiversity Hotspot and shelters rare animals such as the western chimpanzee and the Nimba otter shrew.
